decision.case_state: Stage result, on hold waiting for provider. Works reported done by Clarke (event 031); invoice £333.26 inc VAT is ~40% above approved £198.37 + VAT quote. Payment held; provider asked to explain and send photos; landlord informed.

next_actions.action: Ask Clarke to explain the invoice overage, itemise, give attendance date and send photos
Tell landlord of the over-quote invoice, payment held, no extra spend without agreement
Review provider reply by 2025-10-10; escalate to accounts if unresolved

boundaries: Recording the invoice does not approve it for payment
Payment hold does not decide the dispute
Work completion is only the provider's claim until photos arrive
remaining_work: Landlord decision if extra cost is justified
Accounts escalation P2 if unresolved after 2025-10-10
Close ticket after checks; no tenant (void)
decision.summary: Contractor reports works done but invoiced about 40% above the approved quote. I recorded the invoice, held payment, asked Clarke to explain and send photos, informed the landlord and set a review for 2025-10-10.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: Works reported complete; invoice £333.26 inc VAT vs approved £198.37 + VAT. Outstanding: explanation, photos, landlord view on overage, payment decision, closure.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Email to Clarke (provider) asking for explanation and photos, and email to the landlord informing them; payment held.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Not yet. If Clarke's answer by 2025-10-10 does not settle the overage, escalate P2 to accounts; paying above the approved quote needs landlord agreement.
